title: FTX and BlockFi reach settlement over claims
notes: Reuters report on the settlement that materially improved BlockFi estate recoveries and supported later distributions.

title: BlockFi Plan Administrator Announces Claims Sale and Full Customer Recovery
notes: Official plan-administrator announcement that monetization of FTX claims enabled a near-term final distribution of 100% on allowed customer and general unsecured creditor claims.

title: Haynes Boone secures 100% recovery for BlockFi creditors
notes: Counsel statement confirming that BlockFi bankruptcy recoveries were expected to produce 100% recovery for all allowed claims.
